get.description: Postgres and Redis answer: for dashboards and start-up scripts.

Serving requests. Not the dependencies: they're shared, so an outage of one would
take every pod out of rotation at once (see /health/dependencies).

post.description:
Director's next turn while a member describes a template: a reaction and at most
one question, or ready to write their shots.

Cuts a recorded attempt out of its session's footage into a take: Director's marks
snapped to the first and last words, never across a pause (RECORDING_CLIP_FAILED when
there's nothing to cut; UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE while the footage can't be reached).

200.description: The attempt's take, an MP4; where it was cut in the part's clock in the x-clip-start-ms and x-clip-end-ms headers.

post.description:
A plan of the member's own, from their brief and photos, queued to be written
(DIRECTOR_CREATE_LIMIT past the day's limit).

put.description: Saves the member's changes to the shots of a plan they described.

get.description: Every cut of the caller's, newest first.

post.description: Records a cut of the caller's, from their takes picked one per shot.

get.description: One of the caller's cuts (DIRECTOR_CUT_NOT_FOUND unless it's theirs).

post.description: Director's answer to a request in the editor: edits, a question, or a kind no.

get.description: The workspace's plans, and whether the caller has indexed their own short.

post.description: Where something Director names is in one camera frame, for a mark on screen.

Lines up a match cut between two takes: Gemini locates the anchor in the frames
either side of the cut, OpenCV refines it, and the answer says where to cut and how
to move the incoming clip so the anchor stays put (status `not-found` when it can't
be seen in both).

The workspace's plan for a short; asking queues its analysis when there is none,
as the caller's one short of their own (DIRECTOR_INDEX_LIMIT past it).

get.description:
The workspace's plan for a short, with the default images of its assets (and a
created plan's storyboard cards).

Every asset slot of the plan, with its default and the caller's own images, the one
each uses, and the caller's images left.

post.description: The image the caller's video uses in the slot (none: its default).

Queues an image for the slot drawn from the caller's prompt, or an edit of another
of its images (DIRECTOR_IMAGE_LIMIT past the caller's images).
Records an upload of the caller's, or a stock picture, for the slot.

The caller's choice of take for a shot, over Director's pick; no take goes back to
